verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken layout: the VOLTSTRIDE box, the original's hero, is shrunk to an unreadable scrap in the lower-left corner; the green panel is pushed right, leaving the 48H badge and box stranded on busy stripes; and there is a big dead gap inside the panel. A's headline breaks one word per line, which reads choppily but fills the panel better. B's two-line headline runs almost into the panel's side edges and leaves an even larger empty block mid-panel.
